SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT (SAR) — INVESTIGATION NARRATIVE
Case Reference: HHG-020

I. SUMMARY (WHAT):
Between 2016-12-03 12:04:26 and 2016-12-03 12:04:26, suspicious transaction activity totaling $125.08 USD was identified across 1 transaction(s) involving card C12265-K2 associated with customer profile C12265. The primary suspicious pattern identified is 'card_not_present_new_device'.

II. SUBJECTS & INSTRUMENTS (WHO):
Primary Customer Identifier: C12265
Primary Card Number Reference: C12265-K2
Connected / Correlated Cards: C11923, C07987, C02354
Associated Device Telemetry: Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080

III. TIMELINE & GEOGRAPHIC PROFILE (WHEN & WHERE):
Earliest Flagged Transaction Date: 2016-12-03 12:04:26
Latest Activity Timestamp: 2016-12-03 12:04:26
Affected Transaction Record IDs: 3509359

IV. METHOD OF OPERATION & EVIDENCE (WHY & HOW):
Transaction in established billing region 264.0 (cardholder has 83 prior transactions here).; Device profile Trident/7.0 observed across 3 other distinct customer accounts.; Transaction initiated from a newly observed device profile: Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080.; Cardholder denied authorizing the transaction and confirmed card remains in physical possession.
Multi-Entity Syndicate Linkage: Graph analysis revealed that the device profile (Trident/7.0 | Windows 10 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080) is shared across multiple cardholder profiles, indicating coordinated synthetic identity or card-not-present syndicate activity.

V. INSTITUTIONAL ACTION TAKEN:
The bank initiated immediate card control actions under Bank Fraud Policy v1.0. Customer validation confirmed unauthorized access. The card was permanently blocked and placed on fraud monitoring. This filing is submitted pursuant to BSA/AML compliance mandates.
